title: Lima Sembilan
subject: a woman ham-radio operator on her Bekasi rooftop through the forty-eight-hour CQ World Wide contest, logging stations from Osaka to Rio and Alaska and giving every one of them the same 'five-nine' signal report, while her husband, who grumbles about the cracked roof tiles, brings up her rice and then spends the night replacing those tiles by torchlight under her antenna
caption: Indonesian 80s jazz fusion, keyboard-led jazz-rock with tight unison runs. A Rhodes-style electric piano with chorus comping syncopated ninth chords; a Minimoog-style synth lead playing quick unison lines with a clean fusion electric guitar; an electric bass slapping in the verses and switching to melodic fretless runs in the chorus; tight fusion drums with fast sixteenth hi-hats, ghost notes and tom runs into each chorus; one short odd-meter break. Crisp 1980s studio sound, dry tight drums, wide keyboards. Female lead vocal, agile and bright with a clear jazz tone, quick syllabic delivery, doubling the synth line on the hook. 132 BPM, F minor. Quick, playful and nerdy-proud. No smooth-jazz saxophone, no city pop, no pop ballad, no EDM drums, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short synth and guitar unison run over slap bass]

[Verse 1]
Sabtu jam tujuh pagi, kontes mulai dibuka
Antena yagi di genteng kuputar ke arah Jepang
Kopi satu termos, buku log, pulpen dua
Suamiku teriak dari bawah, gentengnya retak lagi!

[Pre-Chorus]
Si-kyu kontes, di sini Yankee Bravo Satu Alfa Kilo
Siapa pun yang dengar, jawab dong, sebentar aja

[Chorus]
Lima sembilan, lima sembilan
Dari Osaka sampai Rio, semua lima sembilan
Suaranya kresek kayak orang goreng tempe
Tetap kucatat lima sembilan, terima kasih, ganti

[Verse 2]
Malam Minggu di empat puluh meter rame banget
Jepang antre panjang, kujawab satu-satu
Ada bapak-bapak di Alaska, ada anak SMA di Polandia
Suamiku naik bawa nasi, terus ganti genteng sampai subuh

[Chorus]
Lima sembilan, lima sembilan
Dari Alaska sampai Kalimantan, semua lima sembilan
Ada yang nyaris nggak kedengeran
Tetap lima sembilan, ya namanya juga kontes

[Instrumental Break - odd-meter synth and guitar unison]

[Bridge - Rhodes and fretless bass under the vocal]
Seribu dua ratus kontak, suaraku tinggal setengah
Senin jam tujuh pagi, log kututup, aku tepuk tangan sendiri

[Chorus]
Lima sembilan, lima sembilan
Seribu dua ratus kali aku bilang lima sembilan
Suamiku nanya, sinyalmu sekarang berapa?
Kubisikin pelan, tiga tiga, ganti

[Outro - synth and guitar unison run, hard stop]
